assets.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: game background, 1536x1024 landscape
Primary request: A modern Japanese office cubicle island late at night, completely empty of people. One foreground desk is cluttered with a tall stack of papers, a glowing computer monitor casting cold blue-white light, an empty energy drink can, an unbranded stomach-medicine box, and a slightly crooked keyboard. One chair is empty or tipped over. Through the window, night city office lights glow. A wall clock shows just after midnight, but all writing and clock numerals are softly blurred and unreadable. Fluorescent ceiling lights are partly switched off.
Style/medium: hand-painted anime game background, matching the supplied guild-office-day-v1 reference: warm textured brushwork, clean dark ink-like contours, painterly wood and fabric surfaces, polished visual-novel background illustration.
Composition/framing: wide 3:2 background, central desk and key props concentrated near the middle for a narrow 375px smartphone crop; keep far left and far right low-detail. No characters. Do not put logos, company names, or legible text anywhere.
Lighting/mood: quiet, exhausted, memory-like midnight atmosphere; noticeably desaturated gray-blue overall, with the monitor as the main cool accent and only dim practical light.
Color palette: muted gray-blue, charcoal, dusty brown, desaturated beige; reduced saturation compared with the bright fantasy guild-office reference.
Constraints: exactly one empty office scene, no people, no readable words or numbers, no real-world logos, no watermark, no UI frame. Generate a full 1536x1024 image.

assets.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: transparent game character sprite, 512x1024 portrait
Primary request: Full-body silhouette of an angry village mother, shown alone from head to boots, on a genuinely transparent background. She is short and broad/stocky. Her face has no facial features at all: only a near-black charcoal ink silhouette with a very subtle lighter rim highlight so the outline remains readable indoors. Hair is tied back under a triangular headscarf, she wears a simple apron over a homespun dress, and her sleeves are rolled up; one hand rests firmly on her hip and the other arm is bent in a scolding pose. Add two or three small angular steam puffs or sparks around her head to communicate anger.
Input image role: style reference is the supplied Tina design-approved-v1 character: crisp anime contour lines, clean cel-like shading, expressive readable silhouette, polished visual-novel sprite.
Style/medium: anime game character sprite with the same clean linework and restrained cel shading as Tina; use only charcoal-black and dark ink-gray silhouette values plus a thin warm-gray edge highlight, no skin or face color.
Composition/framing: full body centered, head close to the top edge with a small transparent margin, feet fully visible near the bottom, no crop, upright neutral/scolding stance suitable for a 512x1024 visual-novel sprite. Keep the silhouette compact and clearly readable when reduced to 48px.
Lighting/mood: stern, comic anger conveyed only by posture, headscarf, apron, rolled sleeves, and steam/sparks.
Constraints: transparent background with alpha; no scenery, no floor shadow, no text, no logo, no watermark, no facial eyes/nose/mouth/details, no extra people or props. Generate a full 512x1024 portrait image.
